INSERT INTO erp_users (email, role, password_hash, needs_password_change, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.body.email || $json.body.body?.email || "").toLowerCase() }}',
  '{{ $json.body.role || $json.body.body?.role || "admin" }}',
  '{{ $json.body.password || $json.body.body?.password }}',
  TRUE,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET 
  role = EXCLUDED.role, 
  password_hash = EXCLUDED.password_hash, 
  needs_password_change = TRUE;
SELECT 'User created/updated' AS status;

UPDATE erp_users SET password_hash = '{{ $json.body.password || $json.body.body?.password }}', needs_password_change = FALSE WHERE LOWER(email) = '{{ ($json.body.email || $json.body.body?.email || "").toLowerCase() }}';

SELECT id, email, role, needs_password_change, created_at, avatar FROM erp_users ORDER BY created_at DESC;
